channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Steve Clifford | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Steve Clifford from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Chasson Randle on Steve Clifford
item.description:
Chasson Randle, on having Steve Clifford back at shootaround this morning:

“It was great. Just the energy that he brings to our team, the leadership that he brings — it's just great to hear his voice back with us and in-person. He's welcome to be back, for sure. We missed him.”

Chasson Randle on Steve Clifford, May 5, 2021. Source: Twitter @JoshuaBRobbins.

item.title: Nicolas Batum on Steve Clifford
item.description:
Batum on Clifford:

“He trusts me. He believes in me. So that could be a big factor.”

Nicolas Batum on Steve Clifford, Nov 25, 2015. Source: Twitter @rick_bonnell.

item.title: Al Jefferson on Steve Clifford
item.description:
“When [Clifford] comes and talks to me about something I am not doing right, I don’t feel less than a man walking away,”

Al Jefferson on Steve Clifford, Oct 28, 2015. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Mike Conley on Steve Clifford, Josh McRoberts
item.description:
Rick Bonnell:Agent Mike Conley on Josh McRoberts' decision:

“He just labored over it because he so loves (Hornets coach Steve) Clifford.”

Mike Conley on Steve Clifford, Josh McRoberts, Jul 7, 2014. Source: Twitter @rick_bonnell.

item.title: Stan Van Gundy on Steve Clifford
item.description:
Stan Van Gundy on Steve Clifford getting a head coaching job:

“I was really excited. One of the things that I always bragged about is that I was very confident I had the most qualified and best staff in the NBA. Steve was ready to be a head coach from the day he got to the Magic. I hired a guy that was ready to be a head coach, it was just a matter of somebody giving him his opportunity.”

Stan Van Gundy on Steve Clifford, May 31, 2013. Source: 740 The Game.

item.title: Rod Higgins on Steve Clifford
item.description:
Clifford, who has spent the last 13 seasons as an NBA assistant coach, becomes the sixth head coach in franchise history.

“We are excited to have Steve Clifford as our new head coach,”

Rod Higgins on Steve Clifford, May 29, 2013. Source: NBA.com.
